Changes.note: Signing in opens a session for the portal in this browser and ties it to your Medaris session at Keycloak; the other portals in the same browser get in with it without asking. The session is kept in a cookie and the session store and ends with the session at Keycloak when left alone; “Sign out” ends it at once. Signing in as another account ends the browser's old session. Nothing else changes.
